oliver: Heads up — noticing a hole in traces for eu-west inference pool since ~2025-11-12T03:00Z. Kibana returns nothing for several request IDs that Prom metrics show as served. Anyone else seeing this? @oncall-sre

maya: :eyes: saw some gaps earlier, suspected ingest lag. Can you paste one request id?

oliver: request id abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890. Kibana KQL returns 0 results but Prom shows request_count for same id. Query I ran: `trace.id: \"abcdef12-3456-7890-*\"` returns nothing.

simon: For Loki, try LogQL: `{job=\"app-inference\"} |= \"x-request-id=abcdef12-3456\" | json | line_format \"{trace_id}\"` Also try searching `trace.parent_id`. We sometimes index request headers as `http.request.headers.x_request_id` (underscores).

katie: We rolled a small change last night that switched some clients to `x-correlation-id` instead of `x-request-id`. Could be mixed header names right now. Try both in KQL: `http.request.headers.x_request_id : \"abcdef12*\" OR http.request.headers.x_correlation_id : \"abcdef12*\"`.

oliver: Running Loki query now — I actually found entries under a different header and a different trace id prefix. Also saw a node restart around the time: `node: eu-west-infer-12` restarted at 2025-11-12T03:05Z. Kubectl snippet I used: ```kubectl get pods -n inference node-12 -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState}'``` The pod termination message shows OOMKilled + container restarted.

simon: If the otel-collector dropped spans during restart, traces won't show even if stdout logs exist. Check otel ingestion logs: `\{component=\"otel-collector\"\} |= \"drop\"` or search for `failed to export` errors. Also check the trace sampling config — we recently lowered sampling for noisy paths.

maya: I'm going to add a short alert: if Kibana trace lookup for a given request_id returns 0 while Prom `inference_requests_total{request_id=~\"abcdef12.*\"}` > 0 in the same minute, open a ticket. We should have a 60s grace to avoid noise.

oliver: Good plan. For the hunt, recommended workflow: 1) use Prom to get exact timestamp window for the request_id, 2) query Loki/Kibana with `@timestamp` +/-30s, 3) search both `trace.id` and any `http.request.headers.*` fields, and 4) if no spans, check otel-collector + ingest pipeline for drops.

katie: :thumbsup: I'll update the eng-sre runbook with two example queries and the node restart checklist (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eng-sre/trace-hunt).

deploy-bot: deploy: ingest-pipeline v2.4.1 rolled to eu-west at 2025-11-12T02:58:12Z

oncall-sre: I'm oncall — looking at otel metrics now, will post logs if I find a clear drop.

oliver: Thanks all — keeping this open until we confirm whether span loss or header rename is root cause. If anyone else sees other request ids with same pattern ping here.
